preconditions.description: arr is a list of strings with length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Every element in arr is a string containing only lowercase English alphabets.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(str_val, str) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in str_val)
preconditions.description: str_val is a string containing only lowercase English alphabets.
k is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
n is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The length of str_val is at least k, ensuring a k-length prefix exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for s in arr if len(s) >= k and s[:k] == str_val[:k])
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of strings in arr that have a length of at least k and whose first k characters match the first k characters of str_val.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, int) and return_value >= 0 and return_value <= n
postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer not exceeding the size of the array.
